dose.text: Briefly, cells were loaded with DHR (10 μmol L−1 for 20 min), and were treated with (1) 1 mmol L−1 H2O2 for 30 min; (2) 1 mg mL−1 soybean peptide fractions for 1 h, and (3) 1 mg mL−1 soybean peptide fractions for 1 h and 1 mmol L−1 H2O2 for 30 min.

endpoint.text: All protein samples were quantified by the bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay using bovine serum albumin (BSA) as standard, and stored at −80 ◦ C until digestion.

reported_results.text: The two most active fractions (2 and 3) were then characterized by a peptidomic approach and database search, as well as by a suspect screening approach, in order to identify potential antioxidant amino acid sequences.

numbers.text: Briefly, cells were loaded with DHR (10 μmol L−1 for 20 min), and were treated with (1) 1 mmol L−1 H2O2 for 30 min; (2) 1 mg mL−1 soybean peptide fractions for 1 h, and (3) 1 mg mL−1 soybean peptide fractions for 1 h and 1 mmol L−1 H2O2 for 30 min.
All protein samples were quantified by the bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay using bovine serum albumin (BSA) as standard, and stored at −80 ◦ C until digestion.

The two most active fractions (2 and 3) were then characterized by a peptidomic approach and database search, as well as by a suspect screening approach, in order to identify potential antioxidant amino acid sequences.
